title: Public AC1032 TABLE witness source screen
question: Is there a public, provenance-bound AC1032 AutoCAD/ObjectARX TABLE drawing with independently known cell/style semantics that can replace the damaged ODA-exported candidate?

searches: AC1032 ACAD_TABLE TABLECONTENT DWG sample GitHub

downloadAttempt.result: Fetched once after an approved network retry; 227008 bytes, SHA-256 3c95e8a82d5c8c251483fabc61efa8ca904f4e4bc8c2fce4786d74e812284d07. Header is AC1021 (R2007), so it fails the P5-D AC1024 requirement. Per the stop condition, TABLECONTENT/CELLSTYLEMAP profile was not inspected. Kept outside the repository; no fixture was added.

candidates.name: Autodesk Blocks and Tables sample set
candidates.known: Autodesk describes these as sample files applicable to AutoCAD 2010 and later. A separate public Autodesk University handout names the imperial file in an AutoCAD 2010 workflow.
candidates.unresolved: The TABLECONTENT/CELLSTYLEMAP profile and expected table values were intentionally not inspected after the file failed the required AC1024 version gate. The file is not an AC1032 witness.
candidates.disposition: Exclude for P5-D: AC1021 is below its AC1024 requirement. Stop; do not fetch or scan again. Use the bundled producer session. No support promotion.

candidates.name: ACadSharp samples/sample_AC1032.dwg
candidates.independentFinding: The ACadSharp maintainer says its samples directory contains reader-test files (https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp/discussions/520). A later ACadSharp issue identifies sample_AC1032.dwg as written with DxfWriter and states that DxfWriter emits no ACAD_TABLE or TABLECONTENT (https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp/issues/1253).
candidates.disposition: Exclude as an ACAD_TABLE source witness; do not repeat this candidate.

candidates.name: CadCraft columns-sample.dwg
candidates.independentFinding: The report identifies an AutoCAD 2024/R2018 sample but explicitly says the file has no ACAD_TABLE.
candidates.disposition: Exclude for P6-C TABLE; do not repeat this candidate.

candidates.name: CadCraft AutoCAD luminaire schedule report
candidates.independentFinding: The report describes a real AutoCAD TABLE and concrete rendering/value behavior, but the public issue page does not expose a sample DWG or a source download.
candidates.disposition: Useful semantic lead only; not an acquirable source witness from the public record. No contact was made.

result: No eligible public AC1032 TABLE witness was found. The Autodesk Blocks and Tables Imperial sample is AC1021, so it cannot satisfy P5-D's AC1024 gate; its profile was not inspected. The ACadSharp AC1032 sample and the reported CadCraft columns sample cannot satisfy P6-C.

planEffect.completedAction: Screened the named public TABLE candidates, fetched the Autodesk Imperial sample once, recorded its AC1021 header and excluded it for P5-D, and preserved the ACadSharp/CadCraft exclusions.
planEffect.remainingAction: Use the bundled producer session for an AC1024 TABLE source and for a clean AC1032 TABLE with known expected values. Until P6-C has a clean admissible source, retain raw-only behavior and fail closed.
